articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Amplification Strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Raman amplifiers and rare-earth doped fiber amplifiers are promising candidates for increasing the capacity of fiber optical links by opening up new wavelength ranges in the near future. These technologies are compared in different scenarios considering short-term and mid-term availability of qualified components.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Transmission Systems using SOAs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Ultra-wideband transmission systems are appealing to scale optical fiber capacity. Among technologies under investigation, novel ultra-wideband SOA-based devices, exhibiting high gain over 100+nm optical bandwidth, high output saturation power and low noise figure, have enabled multiple record transmissions and rekindled the interest for SOAs.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated WDM switches and filters for ultra-wideband (O to L) optical networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate multi-band (O- to L-band) monolithic and hybrid photonic integrated wavelength selective switches with fast switching and different data format and data-rates for flexible low-cost 5G/6G optical metro and access distribution networks. We also present results on photonic integrated multiband optical cross-connect switches.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Mid-infrared Photonics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The mid-infrared (mid-IR, 2 - 20 μm wavelength) spectral regime is strategically important for applications such as sensing and imaging. Reconfigurable or tunable mid-IR photonic devices face unique challenges and opportunities unlike their near-IR counterparts due to material choices, wavelength scaling effects, and manufacturing compatibility. This tutorial discusses the operation principles, design trade-offs and application prospects of photonic reconfiguration in the mid-IR spectral range.

articleTitle: Carrier-assisted differential detection using generalized transfer functions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the extension of carrier-assisted differential detection (CADD) from using a conventional interferometer to broad ranges of transfer functions. We show that by using a transfer function based on micro-ring resonator, the receiver sensitivity of CADD can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Benchmarking the Poor Man's Ising Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a Time-Multiplexed Opto-Electronic Oscillator based Coherent Ising Machine(CIM) to solve Maxcut Problems. Time multiplexing helps reduce system complexity and size, with good scaling against problem size. Benchmarks against state-of-the-art classical solvers show comparable performance, with encouraging results for further improvements.

articleTitle: Bi-doped fiber amplifiers for ultra-wideband optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Bismuth (Bi)-doped fibers provide great potential for developing optical amplifiers in the low-loss transmission window, 1250-1650nm, of silica fibers. In this paper, we review recent progress of Bi-doped fiber amplifiers (BDFAs) covering 1345-1460nm spectral region. We also present the BDFA performance at different ambient temperatures.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic processing at 11 Tera-OPs with soliton crystal Kerr microcombs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report a new approach to ONNs based on integrated Kerr micro-combs that is programmable, highly scalable and capable of reaching ultra-high speeds. We demonstrate a single neuron perceptron at 11.9 Giga-OPS at 8 bits per OP, or 95.2 Gbps. We then demonstrate a convolutional accelerator operating beyond 11 TeraOPs/s (TOPs). We test the perceptron on handwritten-digit recognition and cancer-cell detection - achieving over 90% and 85% accuracy, respectively.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable FSR-free microring resonator filter with wide hitless tunability
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a novel design for a reconfigurable silicon microring resonator filter exploiting non-integer Vernier ratio to achieve FSR-free spectral response. Hitless tunability across the extended C+L band (1520 nm-1620 nm) is achieved by introducing controllable loss in the MRRs of the filter.

articleTitle: Establishing free-space optical communication channels through a reconfigurable silicon mesh
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A reconfigurable mesh of silicon Mach-Zehnder Interferometers (MZIs) is employed to manipulate optical beams in order to establish free-space optical communication channels. Automated feedback-control strategies enable the mesh to self-calibrate and maintain the transmission quality in presence of perturbations of the beam front.

articleTitle: Temporal Optical Neurons For Serial Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a three-layer serial optical neural network based on the time-domain Talbot effect for the two-class recognition of English letters “u” & “c” and “a” & “s”, and the recognition accuracy rate reached 100% theoretically.

articleTitle: Multiband Power Control Impact on the Transmission Capacity of Optical Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We apply a launch power control to a C+L+S multiband system, showing an increase in quality of transmission average and flatness, and almost doubling the offered capacity in S-band for long optical line systems.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband WDM Optical Transmission Technologies for Beyond 100-Tb/s Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper reviews studies on the effect of ultrawideband wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) (e.g., interchannel stimulated Raman scattering and optical amplification technique) on optical transmission systems. We also introduce ultra-wideband WDM transmission results for over 100-Tb/s system capacities.

articleTitle: High-performance GeSn Electronic Devices and spin-orbit coupling in GeSn/Ge heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: GeSn is a promising material for high-performance electronic and photonic devices. In this work, we present our recent achievements on high electron mobility in GeSn n-MOSFETs, an extremely low contact resistivity in metal/n-GeSn junctions, and a high tunneling current density in GeSn Esaki diodes with large peak-to-valley current ratios. Last, we present the first two-dimensional hole gas in the undoped GeSn/Ge heterostructures with strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) effects, which is tunable by top gating.

articleTitle: Towards Multi-Band WDM Systems with Hundreds of Terabit/s Transported on one Single-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical networks are facing a tremendous growth of their traffic that can reach up to 40% per year. Multi-band WDM systems have the potential to transmit up to ~200 Tbps over few hundreds of kilometers on one single-mode fiber. We will review the techniques (in particular, optical amplification) that make these systems work.

articleTitle: C+L-band Network Upgrade: Capacity and Energy Analyses with Different Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate the trade-off between network capacity and energy consumption in optical transport networks with three different transceiver implementations. Also, we provide evidence that C+L-band systems have similar energy consumption while attaining comparable network capacity as adding a second optical fiber and using C-band only.

articleTitle: Picosecond optical pulse shaping in strongly injection-locked semiconductor microring lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A method is reported for generating picosecond optical pulses with substantially suppressed transient emission tails in response to applying bipolar injection-current pulses of picosecond duration to a strongly injection-locked whistle-geometry semiconductor microring laser.

articleTitle: Phase Memory of Optical Vortex Beam Scattered by Random Phase Screens
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Properties of vortex beams are significantly affected upon interaction with random phase screens. We provide a quantitative description of the measurable vorticity as a function of variance and spatial correlation properties of distorting media.

articleTitle: Comparison of Wired and Wireless Channel for Short Range Frequency Hopping Terahertz System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present the design of a wired terahertz communication link in a short range (1.5 m) frequency hopping system for secure communication applications. The performance of the system is analyzed based on the frequency dependent terahertz power, responsivity of the detector, dispersion and propagation loss.

articleTitle: Mid-IR Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We describe the framework for a midwave infrared photonic integrated circuit (PIC) that combines lasers, detectors, passive waveguides, and other optical components such as spectral multiplexers and demultiplexers on the native GaSb substrate of an interband cascade laser (ICL) structure.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,2</sup> These building blocks may be used, for example, to fabricate a laser spectroscopy PIC for on-chip chemical sensing.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>

articleTitle: Solving the two-way Number-Partitioning Problem using a Spatial-Photonic Ising Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate an adiabatic evolution scheme to evolve from the ground state of a known Hamiltonian to a Mattis-spin glass Hamiltonian, which corresponds to solving a two-way Number-Partitioning Problem (NPP), using a Spatial-Photonic Ising Machine (SPIM) with a magnified readout plane.

articleTitle: Impact of stimulated Raman scattering on ultrawideband systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Ultrawideband transmission systems can offer increased capacity in single-mode fibers. Stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) emerges as a critical effect to manage in such systems. Here we outline the impact SRS has on ultrawideband transmission and discuss strategies to limit detrimental effects.

articleTitle: General-Purpose Programmable Photonic Chips
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic chips are becoming more programmable, with connectivity that is reconfigured using electronics and software. This evolution is propelled by artificial intelligence and quantum computing applications. We will discuss more general-purpose circuits that could be deployed in more diverse applications, similar to general-purpose programmable electronics.

articleTitle: Si substrate based GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well infrared photodetector with Ge buffer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Ge buffer layer was introduced between the AlGaAs/GaAs quantum well infrared photodetectors active region and Si substrate, reducing threading dislocation density. The QWIPs on both Si and GaAs substrate exhibit similar responsivity, and detectivity. This work paves the way for CMOS compatible, on-chip mid-infrared detectors.

articleTitle: Simplified Synaptic Receptor for Coherent Optical Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Advancing artificial neural networks to the coherent optical domain offers several advantages, such as a filterless synaptic interconnect with increased routing flexibility. Towards this direction, a coherent synaptic receptor with integrated multiplication function will be experimentally evaluated for a 1-GHz train of 130-ps spikes.

articleTitle: Light twists materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: An optical vortex possessing orbital angular momentum twists a myriad of materials, thereby creating various helical structures. Going beyond light induced helical structures, the optical vortex will also offer exotic fundamental light-matter interactions for advanced optical science and photonics.

articleTitle: Micro/Nano-structured Optical Fiber Gas Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Micro- and nano-structured optical fibers enable compact gas sensors with enhanced sensitivity. This paper overviews recent development in all-fiber gas sensors based on direct absorption, photothermal, photoacoustic and Raman spectroscopies, which have demonstrated detection of multiple gas species down to parts-per-million to parts-per-trillion level.

articleTitle: 37-Air-Core Chalcogenide Ring Fiber with >4000 Radially Fundamental OAM Modes Across C+L Bands
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A 37-air-core ring fiber is proposed to support over 4000 OAM modes for highly dense SDM and maintain radially single-mode condition, featuring <-49 dB crosstalk at 1550 nm and <-20 dB crosstalk across C+L bands after 100-km fiber propagation.

articleTitle: Analysis of temperature-dependent and time-resolved ellipsometry spectra of Ge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The dielectric function of Ge measured with static and time-resolved spectroscopic ellipsometry is analyzed using linear filtering techniques to investigate the temperature dependence of the direct band gap, as well as the temporal evolvement of critical points obtained from femtosecond pumpprobe ellipsometry measurements.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration for a Power Scalable Coherent Vector Beam in a Turbulent Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for generating power scalable vector beams. These beams are created with a coherent combination in the RCP and LCP OAM basis encoded with data. The results show resistance to turbulence in free space propagation under a 16-QAM CE-OFDM encoding scheme.

articleTitle: Multidimensional incoherent digital holography with phase-shifting interferometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present multidimensional information sensing using incoherent digital holography with phase-shifting interferometry. Spatially incoherent light is recorded as an incoherent hologram by incoherent holography and three-dimensional, wavelength, and temporal information is obtained by applying various phase-shifting interferometry techniques such as the computational coherent superposition scheme.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical investigation of the dynamics of spin-polarized carriers in GeSn heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical spin orientation has been reported in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pmb{Ge}_{1-x}\pmb{Sn}_{x}$</tex> alloys unveiling group IV materials as promising candidates for spin-optoelectronic devices. Here we point out that magneto-optical investigations can be leveraged to determine the spin and carrier lifetime without utilizing a time-resolved apparatus.

articleTitle: Mid-IR Gain of Tensile Germanium Waveguide Lasers with SiNx Stress Liners
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We used ab-initio and finite element strain modeling to explain high threshold current densities in reported tensile Ge lasers. Anisotropic strains improve carrier confinement but reduces optical confinement, and intervalence band absorption still dominates. Strain anisotropy increases Jth compared with simple slab models.

articleTitle: Monolithic Mid-IR Methane Gas Sensor with Waveguide-Integrated Detector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic chalcogenide glass spiral waveguide sensor integrated with a PbTe photoconductor detector on-chip for mid-infrared absorption spectroscopic sensing. Current methane gas sensing limit of detection was experimentally measured as 1% by volume, but further optimization should maximize sensitivity to 330 ppmv.

articleTitle: Array-level inverse design for optimized beam directivity in active metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We develop an array-level inverse design framework that accounts for the nonideal optical response to optimize the array configuration of reconfigurable metasurfaces. As an example, we validate this approach experimentally and demonstrate high-directivity beam steering with nonideal antenna components exhibiting a phase shift of ~220°.

articleTitle: Photonic Spiking Convolutional Neural Networks for High-Speed Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A multi-layer photonic spiking convolutional neural network is presented, based on miniaturized VCSELs, targeting image classification. Spatial information is encoded using a time multiplexing scheme providing a radical reduction of physical neuron-count. Hardware-friendliness is enhanced by exploiting unsupervised spike-timing dependent plasticity.

articleTitle: Considerations for brain-scale artificial neural systems in semiconducting and superconducting optoelectronic hardware
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The potential of optoelectronic hardware to achieve brain-scale neuromorphic computing is assessed. Both superconducting and semiconducting systems with direct optical synaptic connections are analyzed. The possibility of integrated memory, the potential for 3D integration, and the limits of optical communication for neural systems are highlighted.

articleTitle: Integrated metasystem for image recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: With lithographically defined inter-layer alignment, we demonstrate diffractive deep optical network on silicon photonic platform, towards broadband spatial pattern classification and hyperspectral imaging. The high-throughput vector-by-matrix multiplications is enabled by 103 passive subwavelength phase shifters as weight elements.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis of Generalized Optical Unitary Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical unitary converters (OUC) that enable reconfigurable unitary transformation between the input and output optical bases has gained increased interest for various applications. We compare different architectures of integrated OUC in terms of fabrication tolerance and demonstrate that all-to-all-coupled interferometer significantly enhances the robustness.

articleTitle: Structuring Light to Rotate Optical Turing Patterns and Solitons
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The interplay of diffraction and self-focussing nonlinearity in an optical cavity results in the formation of spatial Turing patterns. Using helically-phased pumps, the patterns form on rings and rotate. We show how fully-structured light can be used to gain precise control over the rotation speed.

articleTitle: High efficiency end-fire 3-D optical phased array based on multi-layers SiN/SiO platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: OPA device has been widely studied for solid-state Lidar. We have investigated a multi-layers SiN/SiO structure to end-fire the beam with high efficiency. The advantage of the structure, simulation result and fabrication feasibility are discussed. In addition, the latest fabrication progress is also presented.

articleTitle: Ge on Si Photonics Platform for Mid-Infrared Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Mid-infrared spectroscopy in the fingerprint region of the electromagnetic spectrum is demonstrated using a Ge on Si photonic platform technology. Components that can be integrated into complete lab-on-a-chip sensors for spectroscopic identification of healthcare and security analytes is presented capable of parts per billion sensitivity.

articleTitle: Interconnecting hollow-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Low-loss hollow-core fiber interconnection to standard optical fibers paves the way for high-finesse resonators, low-noise sensors, high-power delivery and next-generation fiber-optic communications. We will present main interconnection principles, discuss how back-reflection and higher-order mode excitation can be mitigated, and provide application perspectives.

articleTitle: Mode-division multiplexing for microwave signal processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present an overview of different mode-division multiplexing fiber technologies engineered to provide tunable microwave signal processing, including signal filtering and optical beamforming for phased-array antennas. The exploitation of both the space and wavelength dimensions brings advantages in terms of increased compactness, flexibility and versatility.

Author Keywords: mode-division multiplexing true time delay line

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics for Artificial Intelligence and Neuromorphic Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence and neuromorphic computing driven by neural networks has enabled many applications. Software implementations of neural networks on electronic platforms are limited in speed and energy efficiency. Neuromorphic photonics aims to build processors in which optical hardware mimic neural networks in the brain. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Asynchronous recovery of broadband signals corrupted by in-band noise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate the recovery of signals completely lost under in-band noise, in a real-time and single shot manner. The recovery system operates in a completely asynchronous manner from the signal, offering a versatile and efficient solution to in-band noise mitigation.

articleTitle: First-order phase statistics in Laguerre-Gauss speckles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a statistical analysis of the phase of random fields generated by scattering of Laguerre-Gauss beams. The standard deviation of the speckle phase is studied using the formalism of equiprobability density ellipses.

articleTitle: Distance and spectral power profile shaping using machine learning enabled Raman amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to learn the mapping between the 2D power profiles, (distance and frequency), and the Raman pumps. Using the CNN, the pump powers and wavelengths for arbitrary 2D profiles can be determined with high accuracy.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach to Autonomous Management of Photonic Switching System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a data-driven approach based on Machine Learning (ML) to predict control signals of a photonic switching system. The proposed ML agent is trained and tested in a completely topological and technological agnostic way and we envision its application in real-time control-planes.

articleTitle: Space-Time Wave Packets Interacting With Photonic Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We introduce two classes of non-diffracting spacetime wave packets to serve as platforms for novel interactions with photonic devices: programmable omni-resonant wave packets for planar optical cavities, and hybrid guided modes in planar waveguides with tunable modal indices.

articleTitle: Routing and Spectrum Allocation Heuristic for Sliced Elastic Optical Network System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We proposed a heuristic algorithm, Minimum Hops with Least Slots spectrum (MHLS), to solve the Routing and spectrum assignment problem in elastic optical networks. The proposed MHLS is implemented in conjunction with the transponder supporting slice-ability.

articleTitle: Enhanced Generalized Mach-Zehnder Interferometer for Tunable Channel Routing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A switch-fabric for the channel routing is presented which combines the wavelength-separation-ability of arrayed waveguide gratings (AWGs) with the tunability of generalized Mach-Zehnder interferometers (GMZIs). The resulting tunable filter allows to maximize and shift a desired spectral transmission-window, whereby the window-bandwidth is defined by waveguide-length-offsets.

articleTitle: Momentum (k)-Space Charge Separation Mid-Wave Infrared Photodetectors Using SiGeSn Alloys
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report a band-structure engineering approach with k-space charge-separation feature by tailoring the direct-energy valley to be several kBT higher than the indirect, enabling large absorption coefficients while maintaining long-carrier lifetimes. Modeling shows SiGeSn alloys with constant 3kBTΓ - and L-valley separation cover MWIR range.

articleTitle: Comparison of Cost-effective Solutions to Increase the Capacity of Regional Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper compares cost-effective solutions to increase the capacity of regional optical transport networks. The possibility to explore additional fiber bandwidth is compared to the benefit of improving optical system performance by deploying hybrid EDFA/Raman instead of EDFA amplification only.

articleTitle: Continuous Fabrication of Microstructured Waveguides for THz Communications Using Infinite 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A micro-structured suspended-core waveguide is designed for information transmission at 128 GHz carrier frequency. It is 3D printed using a 45° inclined extruder that enables continuous, length-unlimited fabrication of terahertz waveguides. The experimental characterization demonstrated the promising prospect of such novel technique for waveguide-assisted applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Raman amplifiers using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: It has been recently demonstrated that neural networks can learn the complex pump-signal relations in Raman amplifiers. Here we experimentally show how these neural network models are applied to provide highly-accurate Raman amplifier designs and flexible configuration for ultra-wideband optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Additive manufacturing of reconfigurable two-wire plasmonic circuits for terahertz communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The terahertz communication is an enabling technology for the next-generation communication networks, where the waveguide-based integrated solutions are of great utility. In this work, we propose a new type of modular 3D-printed micro-encapsulated two-wire plasmonic waveguide components to realize reconfigurable terahertz circuits for signal processing.

articleTitle: Photonic implementation of device-independent quantum randomness expansion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We realize the first device-independent quantum randomness expansion experiment secure against quantum side information through quantum probability estimation. 1.08×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> bits of near-uniform random bits are expanded at a latency of about 13.1 h from a photonic loophole-free Bell test with record-high single-photon detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Space-time wave packets: A new class of spatio-temporally structured light waves
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Space-time wave packets are a class of pulsed beams whose distinguishing characteristic is that they are endowed with precise spatio-temporal structure. Here we present recent results with space-time wave packets including anomalous refraction across a planar interface and accelerating and decelerating pulses in free space.

articleTitle: Infrared Progammable Nanophotonics using the plasmonic Phase-Change Material In3SbTe2
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The infrared plasmonic phase-change material In3SbTe2 (IST) can be switched between dielectric and metallic. It allows direct optical reversible writing of plasmonic antennas for resonance tuning, tunable absorbers, and nanoscale screening and soldering.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional intensity correlations in random fields generated by vortex structured beams
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We developed a general model for the three-dimensional spatial coherence function of speckle fields generated by scattering of vortex beams. The model describes the correlation function along transversal and longitudinal directions, and provides for means for controlling the coherence function via vortex parameters.

articleTitle: Maritime Applications of Higher Order Bessel Beams Integrated with Time (HOBBIT)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the applications of Higher Order Bessel Beams with temporal modulation of Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) for maritime applications. Examples include the creation and detection of HOBBIT beams at unprecedented time scales and power densities. Results are also presented for sensing of rotating fog clouds and nonlinear interactions in water.

articleTitle: Beyond Two-Octave OAM Supercontinuum Generation in Gemanium-Doped Ring-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Supercontinuum of light-carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) is generated over two-octave spectral range by launching a 56-fs 120-kW hyperbolic secant pulse in a 15-cm 50mol% Ge-doped ring-core silica fiber, covering 2350-nm bandwidth from 680 nm to 3030 nm at -40 dB.

articleTitle: Real-time measurements of 200-600Gbit/s digital coherent signals in UWB systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present results for real-time coherent transmission with data rates from 200 Gb/s to 600 Gb/s in both pluggable and non-pluggable DCO modules. Performance is tested both back-to-back and over fiber.

articleTitle: InAs/GaAs Quantum-Dot Lasers Monolithically Grown on on-axis Silicon (001)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Inversion boundaries (IBs) are charged planer defects that arise from the growth of polar III-V materials on non-polar Si (001) substrate. This paper demonstrates a novel technique to achieve all-MBE grown, IB-free GaAs on on-axis Si (001) substrates by employing periodic Si single-atomic-height steps to re-distribute the nucleation of IBs and promote IB self-annihilation in the subsequent GaAs growth. Furthermore, an electronically pumped quantum-dot (QD) laser has been demonstrated on this IB-free GaAs/Si platform with a maximum operating temperature of 120 °C. These results could be a significant step towards the monolithic integration of III-V materials and devices with mature CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Electronic Properties of Group-IV SnGe alloy topological quantum materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Electronic transport properties of GeSn as a quantum material have been studied. Superconductivity, large magnetoresistance, and quantum oscillations were observed. The combination of such transport properties in one material is rare, implying the great potential of GeSn in fundamental physics research and device applications.

articleTitle: High-speed Structured Light Illumination and Multiple-pixel Detection for Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: High-speed optical implementations for test measurement matrix of compressed sensing are proposed and experimentally demonstrated, including structured illumination using micro-light-emitting diode(LED) array and multiple-pixel detection using a profile sensor. High-speed micro-LED and the light detection in row- and column-wise at once are the key enablers.

articleTitle: Flexible single-crystalline GeSn metal-semiconductor-metal photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We have fabricated flexible GeSn metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) photodetectors (PDs) based on the transfer-printed nanomembranes (NMs). External mechanical strains are introduced by bending fixtures and the effect of strain on optoelectronic performances of the devices is analyzed theoretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Semiconductor nanomembrans and their 3D assemblies for sensitive optical detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topicals Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Semiconductor nanomembranes, as a new focus in nanomaterials family, possess unique properties. The ultra-small thickness makes the nanomembrane soft for flexible applications. The 3D assemblies of the semiconductor nanomembranes with microtubular geometry can effectively confined the light energy and thus lead to sensitive optical detector.

abstract: Provides a schedule of conference events and a listing of which papers were presented in each session.
